Summary
President [OFFICIAL] will join [OFFICIAL] Enemark, chief economist at the San Diego
Regional Policy & Innovation Center, for a fireside chat at the 40th Annual San Diego
County Economic Roundtable to discuss inflation, the labor market, and the economy.
The conversation will be livestreamed and will be made available as a recording
after the event.

[OFFICIAL] is president and CEO of the Reserve Bank and
helps set American monetary policy as a Federal Open Market Committee
participant. Since taking leadership of the SF Fed in 2018, she has chartered a vision
of the Bank as a premier public service organization dedicated to promoting an
economy that works for all Americans and supporting the nation’s financial and
payment systems. Read [OFFICIAL]’s full bio.
